title: 第6章 败坏你们名声
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 辰楠打开门。只见外面站着一男一女。更远处还围观着一些看热闹的邻居。“辰楠！你竟然没事，你掉河里没被淹死？！”常伟逼近辰楠低语，语气咄咄逼人。看到辰楠活生生站在眼前那一刻，他眼睛都红了，他怀疑密室里的东西就是辰楠盗走的！辰楠忍不住笑了出来，“怎么，我没死，你们很失望？”“或者说，你们想我死？”看常伟这番模样，估计是怀疑那些消失的东西与他有关。可他们没证据，着急也只能干瞪眼。柳如意扯了扯常伟的衣袖，上前一步，勉强挤出个白莲花般的笑容。“小楠哥，你别误会，我们就是担心你。”“那日你落水，我们去找人来救你……”“可我们找了很久都没找到，再回来的时候已经不见你踪影。”辰楠看向柳如意，瓜子脸小蛮腰，长相倒是不错，但人品也是真的不行。只是看了柳如意一眼，辰楠就感觉有些压不住心中的恨意。这是源自于原主的情绪执念，可见原主是死了也不安生。“你们不是头也不回地离开了吗？？”“哪怕你们伸出一根棍子，我也不至于呛水那么久。”辰楠冷冷地瞥了柳如意一眼。柳如意被这眼神看得心神一颤，顿时有些语塞。“谁头也不回地走了？”常伟反驳，这事情可不能坐实，“你胡说八道什么！”他觉得柳如意那番话有道理，他们是为了找人来救辰楠的，不是扭头就跑见死不救，此刻怎么能心虚呢。“我说错了吗？”辰楠目光扫过二人，看他们不自然的样子就觉得好笑。“你肯定说错了，”柳如意站了出来，狠狠地白了辰楠一眼，“我们是去找人来救你的，你再这样胡搅蛮缠，我就不理你了。”她每次说出这话的时候，辰楠就会乖乖听话，百试百灵，柳如意对此事早已炉火纯青。“懒得跟你们废话。”辰楠发现跟他们讲话真是浪费时间。这二人都会游泳，就原主不会游泳。柳如意以为她还可以像以往一样拿捏对方。她露出一个甜甜的笑容，对辰楠的态度也好了不少。“有点事想要跟你说一下。”柳如意扭头看了眼围观吃瓜的邻居。“我们先进屋坐嘛，外面人多眼杂的。”她说着就朝屋里走去，就像是把这里当自已家似的。辰楠也未阻止，看着二人进屋他跟着一起进去，顺手把房门给关上，隔绝了外面邻居们的视线。柳如意熟悉地在一张缺了个角的破旧八仙桌坐下，看样子不是第一次来这里。“有什么事情就说吧。”辰楠也随意坐了下来。虽说来者是客，但他连水都不想给这二人倒一点。“辰楠，明人不说暗话。”常伟压低声音，“那批东西不见了，是不是你搞的鬼？”他也知道门外有很多等着看热闹的人，因此说话的声音都压低了不少。辰楠故作惊讶：“东西不见了？什么意思？”“别装傻！”常伟咬牙切齿，“昨晚我们去了密室，所有箱子全都不翼而飞！！是不是你弄走的？”辰楠笑了，果然是为了这事来的，是他做的，但他肯定不会承认。“昨天我掉河水里，你们见死不救，我在鬼门关走了一遭，至今都很虚弱，回家到现在都没出过门。”“这件事大院里的人都能证明，你们现在倒怀疑起我来了？”“倒是你们，是想撇开我独吞吗？”柳如意和常伟对视一眼，显然被问住了。“我们怎么可能独吞，只是...”柳如意欲言又止，“那会是谁？”辰楠耸耸肩：“我怎么知道？或许是你们动静太大，被人发现了呗。”常伟死死盯着辰楠，似乎想从他脸上找出破绽。但辰楠面色如常，全然不似作伪。而且看他脸色有些惨白，应该是昨天掉河里受寒了。“最好不是你。”常伟最终恶狠狠地说，“若是让我知道是你搞鬼...”“怎样？”辰楠挑眉，似笑非笑地看着常伟，“就像昨日在河边一样故意推我掉河里，想杀了我？”话音未落，门外忽然传来一声惊呼：“什么？杀人？”这是王大妈的声音，她不知何时站在门外，显然听到了只言片语。虚掩的门也被推开，此刻她正瞪大眼睛望着屋里。辰楠心中一动，露出一丝坏笑，当即提高了声音。“那日我落水，就是你们推的，你们见死不救扭头就跑，如今还想诬陷我偷了东西，天底下哪有这样的道理！”他这一喊，周围的邻居纷纷围拢过来，对着常伟和柳如意指指点点。“不是，事情不是这样的！”柳如意脸色有些发白地辩解。“我没有推他，是他自已想玩水掉河里的！”常伟大声解释着，这事情打死也不能认，反正当时又没人看到。此话一出，周围的人都一脸怀疑地看着常伟。院子里的大伙都知道辰楠不会游泳，自然不会靠近河道玩水，又怎么会玩水掉河里呢。“推了我还不承认，脸皮是真厚啊！”“今天过来又想把偷东西的罪名按我头上。”常伟听了这话脸色铁青，柳如意则涨红了脸，支支吾吾说不出话。此时，里屋的房门吱呀一声被打开。辰东南拄着临时拐杖走了出来，脸色阴沉地看着常伟二人。二人感受到一股压迫，忍不住后退了几步。他们没想到辰楠他爸竟然在里屋。还不等辰东南有什么动作，辰楠就上前扶住了他，“老爸你风湿老寒腿难受就不要动弹，还是回屋休息吧。”辰楠不由分说的，直接扶着父亲进入里屋。让他在屋里休息，这事情自已就可以解决。辰东南想了想最终也没有反抗，这事情就交给辰楠做吧，这小子是真长大懂事了。常伟眼神阴鸷，死死盯着辰楠，这小子今天让他丢脸了。“小子你皮又痒了，我给你松松骨！”他并不把辰楠放在眼里，以前又不是没揍过他。如今这病秧子还敢在那么多人的面前如此辱他。在辰楠刚关上里屋的门转过身之际，常伟抬起手就朝辰楠的脸上抽去。辰楠冷笑一声，他还想着以什么理由来动手，没想到对方竟然先动手，这不是给了他一个动手的理由么。当下他也不多想，侧身躲过打来的巴掌，反手就抽了回去。“啪——”一记耳光声响彻在院子里。院子里顿时一片死寂，所有人都惊呆了。谁能想到说着说着就动起了手。常伟捂着迅速红肿起来的脸颊，眼睛瞪得滚圆，仿佛不敢相信刚才发生了什么。“你...你敢打我？”常伟的声音因震惊而颤抖，随即转为暴怒，“你不想活了！”常伟大喊一声就挥拳朝辰楠面门砸去。他比辰楠矮半个头，但体格比辰楠壮硕，这一拳带着风声，眼看就要击中。然而辰楠不闪不避，只是轻巧地抬手，精准地抓住了常伟的手腕往后一拉。常伟只觉得自已的拳头像是砸进了一道铁箍，人也往前一个趔趄，差点没摔倒在地上。“我不动手等着被你打吗？”辰楠冷冷道，“我这是反击自保，打你怎么了？”他手上稍稍用力，力道比平时大了些。这就是灵泉溪水的效果，以前这身体可没这样的力道。常伟痛得龇牙咧嘴，额头上渗出冷汗。他试图挣脱，却发现辰楠的手如铁钳般牢固。
content_en: Chen Nan opened the door.I saw a man and a woman standing outside.Further away, there were some neighbors watching the fun."Chen Nan! You're okay, you fell into the river and didn't drown?!" Chang Wei approached Chen Nan and whispered in an aggressive tone.The moment he saw Chen Nan standing in front of him alive, his eyes turned red. He suspected that Chen Nan had stolen the things in the secret room!Chen Nan couldn't help laughing, "Why, you're disappointed that I'm not dead?" "Or, do you want me to die?" Looking at Chang Wei's appearance, he probably suspected that the disappearing things were related to him.But they had no evidence, so they could only stare blankly if they were anxious.Liu Ruyi tugged on Chang Wei's sleeves, took a step forward, and forced a white lotus-like smile."Brother Xiaonan, don't get me wrong, we are just worried about you." "That day when you fell into the water, we went to find someone to rescue you..." "But we searched for a long time and couldn't find you. When we came back, you were nowhere to be seen." Chen Nan looked at Liu Ruyi. She had an oval face and a slim waist. She looked good, but her character was really bad.Just looking at Liu Ruyi, Chen Nan felt that he could not suppress the hatred in his heart.This is due to the emotional obsession of the original owner, which shows that the original owner is not happy even after death."Didn't you leave without looking back?" "Even if you stretched out a stick, I wouldn't have choked on the water for that long." Chen Nan glanced at Liu Ruyi coldly.Liu Ruyi's heart trembled at the look, and she was suddenly speechless."Who left without looking back?" Chang Wei retorted, this matter cannot be true, "What nonsense are you talking about!" He felt that Liu Ruyi's words were reasonable. They were looking for someone to save Chen Nan, and they didn't just turn around and run away to die. How could they feel guilty at this moment."Did I say something wrong?" Chen Nan glanced at the two of them and felt funny when they looked unnatural."You must have said something wrong," Liu Ruyi stood up and gave Chen Nan a hard look, "We are here to find someone to rescue you. If you keep messing around like this, I will ignore you." Every time she said this, Chen Nan would be obedient and try everything. Liu Ruyi was already proficient in this matter."I'm too lazy to talk nonsense with you." Chen Nan found that talking to them was a waste of time.Both of them can swim, but the original owner cannot swim.Liu Ruyi thought she could still control him as before.She showed a sweet smile, and her attitude towards Chen Nan became much better."I have something to tell you." Liu Ruyi turned to look at the neighbors who were watching the melon."Let's sit in the room first. There are many people outside." She said and walked towards the room, as if she regarded this place as her own home.Chen Nan didn't stop them either. He watched the two of them enter the house and followed them in. He closed the door and blocked the sight of the neighbors outside.Liu Ruyi sat down familiarly on a dilapidated Eight Immortals table with a corner missing. It seemed that this was not her first time here."Just tell me if you have anything." Chen Nan also sat down casually.Although they were guests, he didn't even want to pour some water for these two people."Chen Nan, Ming people don't tell secrets." Chang Wei lowered his voice, "The batch of things disappeared, is it your fault?" He also knew that there were many people outside the door waiting to watch the fun, so he spoke in a much lower voice.Chen Nan pretended to be surprised: "Things are missing? What do you mean?" "Don't pretend to be stupid!" Chang Wei gritted his teeth, "We went to the secret room last night, and all the boxes were missing!! Did you take them away?" Chen Nan smiled. Sure enough, he came here for this matter, and it was him who did it, but he would definitely not admit it."Yesterday I fell into the river, and you didn't save me. I walked through the gate of hell, and I'm still very weak. I haven't left the house until I got home." "Everyone in the compound can testify to this, but now you are suspicious of me?" "You, on the other hand, want to leave me alone?" Liu Ruyi and Chang Wei looked at each other, obviously confused by the question."How can we monopolize it, just..." Liu Ruyi hesitated, "Who could it be?" Chen Nan shrugged: "How do I know? Maybe you made too much noise and were discovered." Chang Wei stared at Chen Nan, as if trying to find a flaw in his face.But Chen Nan's expression remained as usual, and he didn't seem to be faking it at all.And judging from his pale face, he must have fallen into the river yesterday and caught the cold."It's better not to be you." Chang Wei finally said viciously, "If I knew it was you who did the trick..." "What?" Chen Nan raised her eyebrows and looked at Chang Wei with a half-smile, "Just like yesterday at the riverside, you deliberately pushed me into the river and wanted to kill me?" Before he finished speaking, there was a sudden exclamation from outside the door: "What? Killing?" This was the voice of Aunt Wang. She was standing outside the door at some point, and she obviously heard a few words.The ajar door was also pushed open, and now she was looking into the room with wide eyes.Chen Nan's heart moved, he smiled evilly, and immediately raised his voice."You were the one who pushed me into the water that day. You turned around and ran away without saving me. Now you still want to frame me for stealing something. How can there be such a reason in the world!" When he shouted, the neighbors gathered around and pointed at Chang Wei and Liu Ruyi."No, that's not what happened!" Liu Ruyi defended with a pale face."I didn't push him, it was him who wanted to play with the water and fell into the river!" Chang Wei explained loudly that he couldn't admit it even to death, and no one saw it at the time anyway.As soon as these words came out, everyone around looked at Chang Wei with suspicion.Everyone in the yard knew that Chen Nan couldn't swim, so naturally he wouldn't play with water near the river, so how could he fall into the river while playing with water."You pushed me and you didn't admit it. You are so shameless!" "I came here today and tried to pin the crime of stealing on me again." Chang Wei's face turned pale after hearing this, while Liu Ruyi blushed and was speechless.At this time, the door of the back room opened with a creak.Chen Southeast walked out with a makeshift cane and looked at Chang Wei and Chang Wei with a gloomy expression.The two felt a pressure and couldn't help but take a few steps back.They didn't expect Chen Nan's father to be in the back room.Before Chen Southeast could make any move, Chen Nan stepped forward to support him, "Dad, if your rheumatism-cold legs feel uncomfortable, don't move. You should go back to the house and rest." Chen Nan couldn't help but help his father into the back room.Let him rest in the house and the matter will be resolved by itself.Chen Nannan thought about it and finally did not resist. Let Chen Nan do this. This kid has really grown up and become sensible.Chang Wei stared at Chen Nan with sinister eyes, this boy had embarrassed him today."Boy, your skin is itchy again. I'll loosen your bones!" He didn't take Chen Nan seriously, and it wasn't like he had never beaten him before.Now this sick man still dares to humiliate him like this in front of so many people.Just as Chen Nan closed the door to the back room and turned around, Chang Wei raised his hand and swiped it towards Chen Nan's face.Chen Nan sneered. He was still thinking of a reason to take action, but he didn't expect that the other party would take action first. Didn't this give him a reason to take action?He didn't think too much at the moment, turned sideways to avoid the slap, and drew it back with his backhand."Pa--" A slap resounded in the yard.There was a sudden silence in the yard, and everyone was stunned.Who would have thought that he would start moving his hands while talking.Chang Wei covered his cheeks that were rapidly reddening and swollen, his eyes widened as if he couldn't believe what just happened."You...you dare to hit me?" Chang Wei's voice trembled with shock, and then turned into rage, "You don't want to live anymore!" Chang Wei shouted and punched Chen Nan in the face.He was half a head shorter than Chen Nan, but physically stronger than Chen Nan. This punch had the sound of wind and was about to hit.However, Chen Nan did not dodge, but raised his hand lightly, accurately grabbed Chang Wei's wrist and pulled him back.Chang Wei felt as if his fist had been smashed into an iron hoop, and he staggered forward, almost falling to the ground."Why don't I take action and wait to be beaten by you?" Chen Nan said coldly, "I'm fighting back to protect myself, what's wrong with hitting you?" He put a little more force on his hand, and the force was stronger than usual.This is the effect of the Lingquan stream. This body did not have such strength before.Chang Wei grimaced in pain, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.He tried to break free, but found that Chen Nan's hand was as firm as an iron pincer.
